answer: Reputation bridge fees: each identity starts with a crystal rating that only rises through completed cross-community transactions, and any new identity must pay a bridge fee proportional to the gap between its rating and the counterparty's. Cloning yields low-rated nodes, so each sybil pays the full bridge fee on every trade. Legitimate identities earn a ripple of fee rebates that compounds with volume, making honest participation cheaper than running N clones.
